title: Baki Hanma
description: Hanma Baki: Son of OgreTo gain the skills he needs to surpass his powerful father, Baki enters Arizona State Prison to take on the notorious inmate known as Mr. Unchained.

episodes.title: S1-E11The Prison Guard talks about it
S2-E22The Biggest Father-Son Fight in History

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 1x1
episodes_data.description: The world is shaken by news of a man taking down a monstrous elephant with his bare hands. Back in Japan, Baki is confronted by a knife-wielding child.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 1x2
episodes_data.description: To train for his eventual battle against his father, Baki spars against an imaginary giant praying mantis he’s created in his mind.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 1x3
episodes_data.description: In the middle of a heavily guarded parade, the President of the United States is kidnapped in plain sight by an unknown young man.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 1x4
episodes_data.description: Baki comes across a man known as “Mr. Second,” a powerful inmate who seems to enjoy special privileges within the prison.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 1x5
episodes_data.description: With just a few weeks left on his sentence, Iron Michael is attacked by triplet hit men hired to make sure the ex-boxing champ never fights again.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 1x6
episodes_data.description: Just as the Mouth triplets are about to finish their attack on Iron Michael, Guevaru rolls in and instigates a fight.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 1x7
episodes_data.description: Guevaru refuses to believe that Biscuit Oliva, the most notorious inmate in the prison, is comfortably serving his sentence in the company of his lover.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 1x8
episodes_data.description: The match between Guevaru and Oliva begins, and the rules are simple: They both hold onto the same piece of cloth and the first one to let go loses.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 1x9
episodes_data.description: Guevaru is fighting for the people of his impoverished homeland, and he won’t go down so easily. Later, Oliva makes a discovery.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 1x10
episodes_data.description: Baki is surrounded by guards with their guns pointed right at him, but he doesn’t seem worried at all — he seems to be planning something.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 1x11
episodes_data.description: Oliva inadvertently kicks off a major incident when he enters Baki’s solitary confinement cell to challenge him to a fight in two weeks' time.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 1x12
episodes_data.description: Baki learns the hard way that he might not be ready to fight the man known as “Mr. Unchained” — Oliva’s power and technique are on another level.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 2x1
episodes_data.description: Captain Strydum pays Baki a visit and gives him some shocking news; scientists have discovered a human preserved in a salt slab from the Jurassic era.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 2x2
episodes_data.description: Soon after the prehistoric human arrives in Tokyo, the fiercest underground fighters in the country attempt to take him on.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 2x3
episodes_data.description: Pickle, who's used to devouring dinosaurs, struggles to find anything to eat in modern day Japan. Hoping to fight him, Retsu offers himself up as prey.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 2x4
episodes_data.description: After Retsu gives him a taste of highly evolved martial arts moves that have been passed on for thousands of years, Pickle suddenly begins to weep.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 2x5
episodes_data.description: On the streets of Shinjuku, Pickle tussles with the legendary street-fighter Kaoru Hanayama, a modern day human with the power of a Jurassic dinosaur.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 2x6
episodes_data.description: Katsumi Orochi has never been able to gain the respect of his peers, but the time may have finally come for him to bring his skills to the next level.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 2x7
episodes_data.description: The moment comes when Pickle recognizes Katsumi as his prey; Katsumi responds by quickly unleashing his new and improved Mach Fist move.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 2x8
episodes_data.description: As riveted spectators look on, Katsumi Orochi sacrifices everything to his supersonic attacks, and yet Pickle continues to get back on his feet.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 2x9
episodes_data.description: It's a past-versus-present battle when Pickle, a powerful prehistoric human, fights a man who has ingested the most advanced performance enhancing drugs.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 2x10
episodes_data.description: Baki enters Pickle’s enclosure and settles in; breathing the same air, eating the same flesh and living as the prehistoric man does.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 2x11
episodes_data.description: The full effects of the 30 foot fall continue to crush Baki. Even Pickle looks disturbed by the sight of his opponent.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 2x12
episodes_data.description: Baki goes on the offensive, visualizing three different dinosaurs at once as he clobbers Pickle, who responds with an unexpected move of his own.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 2x13
episodes_data.description: Having recognized that the man he's now facing is stronger than any opponent he's ever faced, Pickle morphs into his true, all-powerful form.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 2x14
episodes_data.description: Life returns to normal for Baki — but not for long. After bumping into his mother's old colleague, Baki recalls his parents' tumultuous relationship.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 2x15
episodes_data.description: Strydum readies himself to fight Yujiro Hanma. Then Mitsunari Tokunaga talks to the Prime Minister about the upcoming battle between Yujiro and Baki.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 2x16
episodes_data.description: Though training as a boxer, Retsu has no intention of changing his Kenpo fighting style. Then, boxing champ Akio Mani challenges him to a sparring match.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 2x17
episodes_data.description: Legendary boxing promoter Kaiser arrives in Japan and walks into the gym where Retsu is training. Impressed, Kaiser makes him an offer.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 2x18
episodes_data.description: Retsu's first boxing match in America is announced, and it's against former world champion Andrei Valev. Meanwhile, Baki gets a premonition.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 2x19
episodes_data.description: For some reason, Chiharu Shiba keeps trying to fight Baki. Meanwhile, Retsu gets ready to face the battle-hardened boxer, Smoking Joe.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 2x20
episodes_data.description: Despite getting clobbered, Chiharu Shiba never gives up — and Baki wants to copy his relentless style. A series of hard knocks leaves Retsu reeling.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 2x21
episodes_data.description: Baki cooks some food and sets his table; and sure enough, his father arrives and sits down. But this isn’t going to be a normal family meal.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 2x22
episodes_data.description: Their nice meal at a fancy hotel turns violent when Baki asks Yujiro a personal question, setting off a sky high scuffle for the ages.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 2x23
episodes_data.description: Baki counters his father's attacks by visualizing a cockroach. Meanwhile, word of the epic battle starts to spread and a huge crowd begins to gather.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 2x24
episodes_data.description: As a growing crowd looks on, the father-son battle continues. Baki puts his father on the offensive with a triceratops attack.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 2x25
episodes_data.description: Using an ancient battlefield move, Baki is finally able to subdue Yujiro in what should be an inescapable move. But then, Baki notices his father's hand.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 2x26
episodes_data.description: Yujiro uses his secret, highly effective "dress" move, grabbing Baki and spinning him around with such speed, his son begins to lose consciousness.

episodes_data.title: Baki Hanma 2x27
episodes_data.description: Their battle has exceeded all expectations; and now, the family feud between the most powerful being in the world and his son reaches its conclusion.
